# InNetworkPowerRouting

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A neuromorphic-inspired approach to routing power flows within the grid using in-network processing nodes that adaptively reconfigure based on real-time stability signals. Enables iNEST to demonstrate how neuromorphic computing can handle real-time grid reconfiguration without centralized control.
